name: St. Regis Hotel, San Francisco
positioning: The St. Regis San Francisco, in SoMa's Williams Building next to SFMOMA, sharing its building with the Museum of the African Diaspora
best_for: Art and museum lovers who want SFMOMA and MoAD on the doorstep
Suite guests who want St. Regis Butler service

facts.text: The hotel is housed within the Williams Building, a 20th-century landmark.
The hotel is adjacent to the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA).
The hotel is within walking distance of the Moscone Center and the Yerba Buena Center for the Arts.
The spa features cedar saunas, eucalyptus steam rooms and a Himalayan Salt Room.
The hotel has an indoor infinity pool.
Astra serves modern American cuisine made with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.
Champagne A La Carte at The St. Regis Bar features champagne and caviar pairings and oysters.
Afternoon tea in The Salon is inspired by Caroline Astor and features selections from TEALEAVES.
Suite guests receive St. Regis Butler service, including unpacking and packing, morning beverage service, garment pressing and shoe shine.
The St. Regis Suites are on the 19th and 20th floors and have views of San Francisco Bay.
Bathrooms have soaking tubs and separate shower areas.

highlights.text: The hotel's building is home to the Museum of the African Diaspora (MoAD).
The Golden Gate Mary is the hotel's local version of the St. Regis Bloody Mary, inspired by the sunset over the Pacific.
A champagne sabrage ceremony is presented each evening in the bar.
The spa spans 9,000 square feet across two levels.
Child-sized robes and slippers are available, and the Astor Library Cart offers children's books for bedtime reading.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle.
Dogs are welcome but not in the restaurant, bar, spa, pool or fitness center.
WhataHotel notes an urban location in a busy downtown area.
